name: Diligent Media Corporation Ltd
about: Diligent Media Corp. Ltd is engaged in the printing and publication of newspapers, magazines, books, inserts, and annual reports. It also publishes online newspaper.
keyPoints:
History[1]
Diligent Media was formed in Feb 2005, as a joint venture between Essel group and Bhaskar group which is India’s leading media giant and it began its journey with launch of the Mumbai Edition of Daily News Analysis (DNA) which is an English daily broadsheet.

cons: Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.53 Cr.
Company has high debtors of 396 days.
Working capital days have increased from 690 days to 5,060 days
